restaurantName: Caffe Concerto - The Grand by Concerto
bio: Why not treat yourself to a wonderful Afternoon Tea in the heart of one of London's most buzzing areas at Caffe Concerto - The Grand by Concerto?  Located in the heart of London, moments away from the most prestigious shops and London's most exciting postcode, The Grand by Concerto features an elegant airy atmosphere and timeless décor.  Their Afternoon Tea is a classic interpretation of the British tradition consisting of delicate finger sandwiches with sumptuous fillings, freshly baked raisin and plain scones, alongside a delicious assortment of pastries and cakes. Guests feeling in a decadent mood can upgrade to include a glass of prosecco.  This Caffe Concerto site is situated just a short walk from Piccadilly Circus station.
pageTitle: Caffe Concerto - The Grand by Concerto
